transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: When travelling on TransMilenio, get off at Portal El Dorado and transfer to feeder bus 16-14 Airport or bus K86. According to the airport, both routes go directly to the terminals.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.hint: Free shuttle between T1 and T2
terminals.text: A free shuttle connects El Dorado Terminals 1 and 2. It operates daily from 04:00 to midnight and has a ramp for passengers with reduced mobility.

parking.title: Parking
parking.hint: Short and long stays at Terminal 1
parking.text: Short Stay Parking — Center is in the central part of Terminal 1, with access to domestic and international flight areas. For stays of several days, Long Stay Parking — North is near Gate 1 of Terminal 1, with some spaces under cover. Parking areas have spaces for cars and bicycles, as well as designated spaces for passengers with reduced mobility.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Airport_El_Dorado Wi-Fi is available to passengers and visitors. To connect, select the network, enter your details on the access portal and open a browser. If the connection drops, you can reconnect free of charge as often as needed. Premium WiFi is also sold, providing a continuous connection for 1 device.
